review_scope: Read-only independent review of the frozen V2 numerical execution protocol.

checks.evidence: Pure absolute cache/replay tolerances are frozen at logprob=0.0625, entropy=0.0625 and signed_margin=0.5 with rtol=0 and inclusive boundaries. They are derived only from the first label-free V1 diagnosis by one common binary guard-band rule.
On the fixed eight-claim smoke only, an argmax mismatch is allowed only when cached_margin<=0.5 and replay signed margin for the cached token>=-0.5; any high-confidence path conflict fails.

Cross-path continuous tolerances and high-confidence argmax-conflict checks are hard gates only on smoke. Full extraction must record all drift and mismatch summaries but cannot filter, zero, retry or retune rows because of them.

KV-cached greedy decode is authoritative for generated IDs and generation-time logprob, entropy and margin. Full no-cache replay is authoritative only for hidden64 and attention. Replay token statistics are QA-only and cannot enter features.
Shortest and longest claims repeat cached generation with exact token IDs and cached statistics at rtol=0, atol=1e-6; replay hidden64 and attention repeat at rtol=0, atol=1e-6.

Full extraction remains fail-closed for nonfinite authoritative values and shape, ID, position, offset, hash, runtime-stack or atomic-record inconsistency. Replay teacher-forcing target IDs must exactly equal the cached sequence.
V2 is version-isolated from V1, and no fit gold may be opened before feature freeze and independent review; calibration and official test remain sealed.

implementation_notes: Repeat review should cover p3_ratio_token_mean, p3_ratio_token_min, p3_ratio_token_max, p3_passage_mass_mean, p3_claim_mass_mean and p3_attention_summary256.
The ban on zero filling because of parse-invalid does not remove the V1-frozen T=0 zero rule for token, hidden and attention blocks.

decision.reason: A new V2 runner, CPU selfcheck, independent static runner review, GPU smoke and independent smoke review remain required.
